message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, dated "11-17 MARET 2019." The top section is white with red and black text, including "SIMPANG-SIUR NARKOTIK ANDI ARIEF" and "KRIMINALISASI PENGKRITIK TNI." Below, the large red masthead reads "TEMPO" over the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The central image occupies the lower two-thirds, set against a pink background with a darker pink halftone dot pattern. A large white speech bubble contains the bold black title "ENAM MENGUAK SENAYAN," followed by a paragraph of smaller black text. The bubble obscures the head of a central figure.

This figure is a person shown from the chest up, wearing a white button-down shirt. The person’s hands are pulling the shirt open to reveal a dark purple t-shirt underneath. On the center of the t-shirt is a gold emblem featuring a bird with spread wings inside a circular wreath, with the text "DPR - RI" on a banner below. The illustration uses a comic-book style with bold outlines and flat colors. In the bottom right corner, there is a barcode, pricing, and publication details.
